title: Best AI Fine-Tuning Experts (2026): Train Models on Your Data
description: How to hire an AI fine-tuning expert to adapt a model to your data: when to fine-tune, data, evaluation, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: AI fine-tuning experts adapt an existing AI model to your needs by training it further on your examples: a specific writing style, a classification task, a domain vocabulary or a structured output format. Fine-tuning can improve consistency, but it is not always the right tool. Projects go wrong when there is too little good data, nobody measures results, or the problem could have been solved with better prompts or document search. This guide helps you decide and hire well.

faq.q: Do I need fine-tuning or just better prompts?
faq.a: Try prompts and document search first. Fine-tuning helps when you need a consistent style or format across many examples that prompts alone cannot achieve.

faq.q: How much data do I need?
faq.a: It depends on the task. You usually need many clean, consistent examples of input and ideal output. Quality matters more than quantity.
Agree in writing. Check the terms of the model provider as well.

faq.q: How do we know it worked?
faq.a: Compare the fine-tuned model with the original on a set of test examples it has not seen.

faq.q: What does it cost to run?
faq.a: Training has a cost, and using the model has ongoing costs. Ask for both estimates.
